title: Implement a whitespace normalizer with focused tests
description: Create src/normalize.mjs exporting normalizeWhitespace(text) for string inputs. Trim leading and trailing whitespace and collapse each internal whitespace sequence to one ASCII space. Add Node built-in tests in test/normalize.test.mjs for empty input, whitespace-only input, tabs, newlines and unchanged text. Do not introduce dependencies or change unrelated files.

title: Document the verified module
description: After normalize-module is independently verified, inspect its real exports and tests. Write docs/normalize.md with the supported string-input contract, import example, expected output and the actual test command. Do not change implementation or test files. The independent verifier must check the examples against the implementation.
